svg.title: Escape Room Adventure | Item appearances and atomic acquisition

g.text: Escape Room Adventure | Item appearances and atomic acquisition
+acceptsObjectState(objectId: String, key: String, value: String): boolean
+setObjectState(objectId: String, key: String, value: String): void
required held item and ALL Effect targets before mutation.
It returns an immutable plan; no state changes during prepare.
Validate the plan against its exact object/action and configured fields.
Physical lookup of appearingItemIds belongs to Game, after preparation;
an already-held appearance is valid even though absent from ROOM.
applyInteraction performs deterministic state effects and records only
nonrepeatable completedActionIds on the owning Interactable.
Game combines these changes and automatic transfers in one serial command.
The prevalidated commit phase contains no fallible I/O.
StateAccess is private and never returned to callers.
It delegates only to room-owned object state, with no Game/Inventory access.
resultText: descriptive text about the changed room
one-shot completion is recorded on the drawer Interactable
its existing hidden note moves directly from ROOM into INVENTORY
resultText appends "Obtained: Drawer note" only for that new transfer
A repeatable action naming an already-held note never duplicates it.
It may still change object state and always presents its result text.
Effects never add inventory items or unlock either room gate.
Conditions are pure; effects validate every target first.
A validated apply is deterministic and cannot reject midway.
No Condition or Effect receives the whole Game.
Item appearances are immutable Action/ActionPlan metadata;
acquisition is coordinated by Game, outside the state-effect interface.
HTTP, file operations and Swing remain outside this layer.
An already-completed one-shot action or unlocked gate is a no-op
before any required-item or answer validation.
Incorrect items/answers or unmet conditions change nothing.
For interact, any selected item must be in the actual inventory
and match the action's optional requiredItemId.
Object actions use their own state and action completion rules;
Interactables have no Lock field or lock prerequisite.
preflightAcquisition checks ALL plan.appearingItemIds before mutation:
Inventory.contains(id) means skip; otherwise require Room.findCollectable(id).
Templates reject missing/foreign-room appearance IDs before publication.
After state/completion commit, acquireItems moves each remaining SAME item
using takeCollectable, reveal and Inventory.add; it returns only new objects.
Append obtained names only for that returned list; no extra DTO or ledger.
changed=false when object/completion/location state is all unchanged.
useItems resolves the current room's door ItemLock and calls
tryUnlock(inventory). The nonempty requiredItemIds set must
be contained in that inventory; items remain held after success.
submitAnswer validates only the current room's exit TriviaLock.
Door item checks and exit Trivia are independent and may occur
in either order. Leaving requires both gates to be unlocked.
move() requires ACTIVE and both current-room gates, then validates
the one configured successor and its visible-item transfers before mutation.
enterRoom auto-acquires visibleCollectables only in the destination room.
Present nextRoomId enters that room; empty nextRoomId sets ESCAPED.
Room.isFinal() derives from an empty nextRoomId, without another flag.
Final completion uses the same gates and has no bypass command.
New-game construction calls private enterRoom(startingRoomId) before publication.
Starting visible items enter inventory; Start names that new inventory once.
Future visible items remain ROOM until their first entry.
State-constructor restore never enters a room or acquires items again.
Save/load, Trivia, getters and presentation never grant or reannounce items.
Game / Room / Action are views of the SAME classes in the domain diagram.
Remaining fields, queries, constructors and lock subtypes are defined there.
ActionPlan is immutable; effect and condition configurations are immutable.
Templates validate item/object/action references and nonempty door item sets.
Action.appearingItemIds is a read-only set of own-room configured IDs.
Successors form one finite forward path through every room exactly once.
Required items must be obtainable here or earlier without either local gate.
Conditions cannot inspect gate state; effects cannot mutate gates.
Every configured item has one location: ROOM or INVENTORY.
Only successful appearances and first room entry transfer items to inventory.
Generated values instantiate descriptions, results and expected answers once.
UI presents descriptive text, available action buttons and answer input.
Room exit gate is door unlocked AND separate exit Trivia passed, in any order.
Schema 4 snapshots keep item locations and completed actions/locks.
DomainResult is immutable: { code, changed, resultText }.
